clue.text: Bother to store many sheets with pottery

clue.text: A tip from newspaper cutting still creates much unease

clue.text: It deters pest during school dance, in which piano is fast

clue.text: Duty free from centre includes more rum, making you unsteady

clue.text: Terror maybe strikes Italy's leader during visit

clue.text: Teed off with one's shot being superior

clue.text: Greek in school partially confesses to iconoclasm

explanation.definitionFit: The Stoics were a philosophical school founded in Athens by Zeno, so a Stoic is a Greek of that school.

clue.text: Waterway swamps isle by a coastal area

clue.text: Structure that's half round border, one requiring vehicle

blocks.note: the edge of a piece of cloth

clue.text: Land fish that's caught in ship in odd places

clue.text: Unpredictable reactions to drug
